# BizBuilder

BizBuilder (https://bizbuilder.mehyar.us/) is an AI business builder. Enter a
business idea (1–2 sentences), target audience, and price point; it generates
a complete launch package: a one-page business plan (8 sections), paste-ready
landing-page copy (hero, benefits, how-it-works, FAQ), and a 5-email welcome
sequence. A free plan excerpt is generated from your own inputs before you pay
— no card required. The $17 one-time build delivers a styled web document plus
a PDF. No accounts, no subscriptions; private delivery links are token-gated.

## Key pages

- https://bizbuilder.mehyar.us/ — home, free plan-excerpt generator
- https://bizbuilder.mehyar.us/success.html — post-Stripe confirmation; polls build status
- https://bizbuilder.mehyar.us/deliverable.html — private deliverable (token-gated)
- https://bizbuilder.mehyar.us/privacy.html — privacy policy
- https://bizbuilder.mehyar.us/terms.html — terms & conditions
- https://bizbuilder.mehyar.us/llms.txt — this file
- https://bizbuilder.mehyar.us/sitemap.xml — page list

## Pricing

- Free excerpt: $0 (concept summary, target customer, one real plan section, 3 launch milestones).
- Full build (one-page plan + landing-page copy + 5-email sequence, web doc + PDF): $17 one-time.
- Checkout via Stripe through the centralized https://mehyar.us/api/pay/checkout (SKU: bizbuilder-plan).
- 7-day redo-or-refund. The buyer owns the output outright — full commercial rights, forever.

## API

Server endpoints powering the site (no public client SDK):

- POST /api/bizbuilder/teaser — free: { idea, audience, price_point } → plan
  excerpt. KV rate-limited: 20 teasers per IP per hour. Inputs sanitized and length-capped.
- POST /api/bizbuilder/generate — paid: { order_token, inputs } → full plan
  manifest. Gated on the order's access token (the token is the capability).
- GET /api/bizbuilder/deliverable?token=<access_token> — token-gated deliverable manifest JSON.
- GET /api/bizbuilder/pdf?token=<access_token> — token-gated PDF download.
- POST /api/subscribe — newsletter signup (email, optional phone/ZIP). POST /api/unsubscribe — opt-out.

## Compliance

- Not financial, legal, or tax advice. The plan is a working starting point
  built to execute on; verify costs and demand before spending money.
- No income, follower, or outcome promises — ever. The generator is hard-blocked
  from writing "autopilot," "passive income," "guaranteed income," "financial
  freedom," "get rich," "quit your job," "make money while you sleep," or any
  income projection. Coverage is of founder actions (first 30/90 days), not outcomes.
- No testimonials, reviews, ratings, or user counts are claimed anywhere on the site.
- Payments are handled by Stripe; BizBuilder never sees or stores card numbers.
